name: claudashboard
description: Claudashboard: a clean hub pane for Claude Code. Session vitals (model, effort, context, cost, rate limits), live subagent cards, and a mouse + keyboard file explorer with in-pane preview and editor

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: onedark: fixed One Dark colours; theme: follow your Claude Code theme

showHidden.title: Show hidden files
showHidden.description: List dotfiles in the explorer by default (toggle with . in the pane)

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Claudashboard pane when a session starts
